version_semantics.rationale: vNext adds backward-compatible skills, evidence contracts, selective installer capabilities, cross-platform validation, and lifecycle governance while preserving the default full-registry install behavior.
version_semantics.major: Breaking registry/installer contract changes, incompatible default behavior, or removal/renaming of maintained stable interfaces.
version_semantics.minor: Backward-compatible new skills, optional installer capabilities, evidence/validation capabilities, or maintained public behavior additions.
version_semantics.patch: Backward-compatible corrections, documentation/provenance fixes, test hardening, or implementation repairs that do not add a new maintained capability.
version_semantics.tag_policy: When REGISTRY.version changes for a release-ready main commit, publish an immutable Git tag v<version> only after required CI is green.

Validator catches the known encoding failure pattern or equivalent regression fixture.
Validator checks registry status values.
README validator claims match actual checks.

At least three reproducible behavioral cases exist.

limitations: Router runtime obedience remains NOT_RUN; the router corpus is a static contract evaluation.
